claims.claim: A team using the James Webb Space Telescope identified 104 magnified stellar events in the Dragon galaxy 6.5 billion light-years away.
claims.episode_span: A team using the James Webb Space Telescope identified 104 magnified stellar events in the Dragon galaxy 6.5 billion light-years away.
claims.source_title: JWST tracks more than 100 magnified stellar events in the Dragon galaxy
claims.supporting_quote: Using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), a team of astronomers identified 104 magnified stellar events in a galaxy known as the Dragon, located around 6.5 billion light-years away.

claims.claim: This more than doubles the prior record of 44 events in the same galaxy.
claims.episode_span: This more than doubles the prior record of 44 events in the same galaxy.
claims.source_title: JWST tracks more than 100 magnified stellar events in the Dragon galaxy
claims.supporting_quote: This discovery more than doubles the previous record of 44 such detections in the same galaxy.

claims.claim: Researchers at Middle Technical University in Baghdad, led by Deyaa M. N. Mahmood, added an evaporative cellulose pad behind the panel plus intermittent front-surface water sprays.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Middle Technical University in Baghdad, led by Deyaa M. N. Mahmood, added an evaporative cellulose pad behind the panel plus intermittent front-surface water sprays.
claims.source_title: These Solar Panels Stay Cool in Hot Climates
claims.supporting_quote: Mahmood and his team’s strategy involves adding water-spraying nozzles, an evaporative cooling pad, and a temperature sensor to a photovoltaic module.

claims.claim: In Baghdad tests the system lowered panel temperature by 29.7 °C and raised electrical output by roughly 20 percent on a 150-watt module.
claims.episode_span: In Baghdad tests the system lowered panel temperature by 29.7 °C and raised electrical output by roughly 20 percent on a 150-watt module.
claims.source_title: These Solar Panels Stay Cool in Hot Climates
claims.supporting_quote: In the best-performing configuration with a 100-millimeter-thick pad, the panel’s temperature dropped by 29.7 °C relative to an uncooled panel. Electrical conversion efficiency also improved by about 20 percent.

claims.claim: The 100-millimeter-thick cellulose pad proved most effective, dropping surface temperature 29.7 °C below an uncooled reference panel during peak summer hours.
claims.episode_span: The 100-millimeter-thick cellulose pad proved most effective, dropping surface temperature 29.7 °C below an uncooled reference panel during peak summer hours.
claims.source_title: These Solar Panels Stay Cool in Hot Climates
claims.supporting_quote: In the best-performing configuration with a 100-millimeter-thick pad, the panel’s temperature dropped by 29.7 °C relative to an uncooled panel.

claims.claim: Electrical conversion efficiency rose about 20 percent, adding roughly 16.7 watts to the average output of the 150-watt module.
claims.episode_span: Electrical conversion efficiency rose about 20 percent, adding roughly 16.7 watts to the average output of the 150-watt module.
claims.source_title: These Solar Panels Stay Cool in Hot Climates
claims.supporting_quote: The best-performing configuration increased the average electrical output of a 150-watt PV module by approximately 16.7 W.
